answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 8255 Country: India Title: I and my wife came on holidays to india for 15 days,to my suprise my wife booked false dowry case on me and my parents on the saying of his father and he is not letting us communicate, i tried all means to communicate she does not want to communicate, i also tried all the possible duas and prayers to get her back ,but failed, could u please give me any dua for me to get her back i sincerely love her and how do i convenice my parents to accept her,its been 10 months my physical needs are growing , i donot want to commit any adultry please help me with this. Question: I and my wife came on holidays to india for 15 days,to my suprise my wife booked false dowry case on me and my parents on the saying of his father and he is not letting us communicate, i tried all means to communicate she does not want to communicate, i also tried all the possible duas and prayers to get her back ,but failed, could u please give me any dua for me to get her back i sincerely love her and how do i convenice my parents to accept her,its been 10 months my physical needs are growing , i donot want to commit any adultry please help me with this, JazakAllah Khair Answer ID: 8255 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2147/387=TB/1429) Recite ya aziz ( یا عزیز ) after Isha in the state of wudhu facing the house of your in-laws 200 times for forty days. Also, recite durood thrice before and after. In-sha-Allah, their heart will melt down. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
